notes.title: Patch 1.2: Holiday Blitz!
notes.notes:
Salutations, Retail Mages
It’s that time of year again.  The armies of last minute shoppers have smashed through MageMart’s gates.  Push your crafting skills to the limits to complete the orders of waves of procedurally generated customers.  It’s tough going as a solo Retail Mage, so bring your friends and [strike]get the executive team a fat bonus[/strike] ensure every MageMart shopper gets the gift of their dreams!

New Game Mode: Holiday Blitz!
Holiday Blitz mode can be accessed from the main menu and features the following:

 More customers, arriving more frequently.
 Procedurally generated customers, so no game is ever the same.
 A special holiday display area and snowfall vfx.
 An attack action (’T’ key) for when you just need to vent some frustration.

New Feature: Session Customization
Session Customization allows you to modify your games in various ways.  The following options are now available:

 Blitz Mode: Customers spawn in waves of 3, every 2 minutes, up to a maximum of 10 concurrent customers.  Customers only remain in the store for 7 minutes.  Some customers are procedurally generated.
 Christmas: Enables the holiday display area and snowfall vfx.
 Punching: Enables the Punch action (’T’ key).  Beware, NPCs will hit back and remember that you attacked them!  Punch doesn’t affect objects.

Changes

 A santa hat has been added as a hairstyle for player customization.
 Added more narratively unique naming and descriptions to some objects.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the journal and customer reviews sometimes showed incorrect entries.
 Fixed an issue where NPCs could sometimes become unresponsive.

Happy Holidays, Retail Mages!
- The Jam & Tea Team

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1: Achievements!
notes.notes:
Retail Mage now includes achievements!  Get out there and make management proud [strike]or suffer the consequences and get put on a PIP (Personnel Incineration Plan)[/strike].

Major Update

Changes

 Retail Mage now has achievements!
 Added more narratively unique naming and descriptions to some objects.

Bug Fixes

 Re-added some floating cloud signs.
 NPCs should no longer walk on top of flaming braziers and incinerate themselves.
 Fixed some typos.
 Fixed an issue where object offsets weren’t properly replicated to clients, causing players to get stuck in chairs.
 Fixed an issue where NPCs would follow a missing target if multiple players tried to talk to them at once.

Steam Deck Support
Pending a Steam Deck update from Valve, you can do the following to play Retail Mage on Steam Deck:
[olist]
 Select Retail Mage
 Open Retail Mage’s Settings (gear icon on the right)
 Click Properties
 Scroll down to Compatibility
 Check the "Force the use of a compatibility tool" box
 Scroll down and select "Proton Experimental"
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.11
notes.notes:
Minor Update

Changes
- Added sounds when typing in the various menus.
- Added walk sounds when moving at slow speed.
- Added more narratively unique naming and descriptions to some objects.
- First time players will now be encouraged to play the Tutorial the first time they try to Host or Join a game.
- Added controls hints for emotes under the controls menu (‘/’ key).

Bug Fixes
- Fixed Frozen VFX being giant or small on some objects.
- Fixed some hovering items in the level.
- Fixed an issue where thrown objects would collide with the thrower and drop at their feet.
- Fixed an issue where stacked objects wouldn’t fall if one of the lower objects is moved.
- Fixed a cloth object that was extending underground.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Minor Update

Changes
- The Electrified tag is now temporary by default, sorry to those that got stuck in a loop of getting knocked unconscious by infinite electricity! 
- Characters now revive from unconsciousness with 20% HP, up from 10%.
- The Chatlog will now resume auto-scrolling the most recent messages if you haven’t interacted with it for more than 10 seconds.
- Interaction result notifications now stay up for a bit longer.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed some crashes.
- Fixed an issue where the Skill and Strength selection UI could get stuck.
- Fixed some bottles and drinks that were undrinkable because they weren’t tagged to contain liquid.
- Fixed various typos.
- Added more narratively unique naming and descriptions to some objects.
- Fixed the frozen VFX lingering if the frozen object is moved.
- Fixed an issue allowing you to emote while unconscious.

Known Issues
- Frozen VFX is giant or small on some objects (particularly in the Baby Dragon's Room).
